dogecoin.text: Dogecoin, ether, BTC...words used by financial geeks and Reddit nerds have now entered the mainstream. The volatility is crazy, the trade volume is through the roof and yet not everyone knows quite what/why is all this happening. I explain-

“Investing in crypto is like a lottery" one crypto expert told me.

If crypto investing is like lottery or gambling, these WhatsApp groups are the Las Vegas of bitcoin or dogecoin trading. Just that what happens in these groups, does not stay in these groups.
